# MakeHardware — cloud environment "Allowed domains"
#
# Set Network access to **Custom** and TICK
# "Also include default list of common package managers".
# Then paste the lines below (comments are fine to omit).
#
# Why each entry is needed:

# KiCad 10 packages. The Trusted preset allows launchpad.net and the RETIRED
# ppa.launchpad.net, but Launchpad serves PPA content from launchpadcontent.net,
# which is not on that list. Without this line apt-get update only *warns* and
# `apt-get install kicad` silently installs KiCad 7.0.11 from Ubuntu universe —
# which has no IPC API, so Konnect cannot drive it.
ppa.launchpadcontent.net

# Lets Claude read back the vision boards and reports it publishes as Artifacts.
*.frame.claudeusercontent.com

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only needed if you set MH_ENABLE_LTSPICE=1. ngspice covers the default
# simulation loop with no Wine and no download, so leave these out unless you
# specifically need vendor-encrypted ADI models or .asc schematic editing.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ltspice.analog.com
# *.analog.com

# Already covered by the Trusted preset, listed here only so you can see that
# the build depends on them: pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, index.crates.io,
# static.crates.io, static.rust-lang.org, github.com, codeload.github.com,
# archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com, *.ubuntu.com (keyserver.ubuntu.com).
